body.statement: Determine the finite value of \(r_{\beta}(\ell)\) exactly for every \(\ell\ge1\). Using \(\mathfrak H_{\ell}\), prove that for every \(R\ge r_{\beta}(\ell)\) the terminating atlas is nonempty and its domains cover a nonempty relatively Zariski-open subset of \(\mathcal O_{\ell,R}=\Phi_{\ell,R}(\Theta_{\ell,R})\), where every covering chart returns \(\beta\) and all uncovered legal inputs return the common failure value \(\bot\). For every \(2\le R<r_{\beta}(\ell)\), construct a Zariski-dense relatively open subset of \(\mathcal O_{\ell,R}\) whose nonempty legal fibers contain independent finite-support unequal-\(\beta\) twins. The mandatory first decision is the complete saturated \(\ell=2,R=3\) projection \(\{\beta(\theta):\theta\in F_{2,3}(\zeta)\}\) using the finite atomic quantified-real constraints of \(\Theta_{2,3}\) on a relatively open legal image chart; abandon the global converse architecture if no open legal-twin chamber exists there.
body.justification: This is the theorem-level kernel: it closes both the sufficiency and legal-real necessity sides of the minimum-depth problem.
body.gap: The closest paper supplies only \(k(\ell)\)-order sufficiency and a disputed one-latent lower claim; no exact all-\(\ell\) fiber frontier is known.
body.consumer: The result fixes the minimum moment order and the failure certificate used by the companion estimator.

obligation.what_is_open: Determine the complete saturated beta projection of the legal two-representation incidence fiber for \(\ell=2,R=3\), and then classify every remaining intermediate order for general \(\ell\).
obligation.obstruction: At \(\ell=2,R=3\) the structural-to-cumulant map is generically finite rather than positive-dimensional.  The exact nonzero Jacobian determinant rules out the proposed local fiber-curve construction, but it does not decide whether a separate real, moment-feasible unequal-effect branch exists.  No complete saturated real elimination certificate is present in the frozen core.
obligation.attempted: The complete order-two and order-three tensor equations were reduced on a nonzero loading minor to six polynomial equations in the six structural coordinates.  Exact rational Jacobian determinants were computed.  Direct exact Groebner elimination of this six-polynomial system did not terminate in the available calculation, while numerical multistart evidence is not a proof of either uniqueness or a legal twin branch.  Accordingly the mandatory kill test has not certified an open legal-twin chamber, and the global converse extension is not asserted.
obligation.partial_result:
The proved global result is
\[
 L_\ell\le r_\beta(\ell)\le U_\ell,
 \qquad
 \frac{r_\beta(\ell)}{\sqrt{2\ell}}\longrightarrow1,
\]
with the exact values \(r_\beta(1)=3\) and \(r_\beta(3)=4\).  For \(\ell=2\), \(3\le r_\beta(2)\le4\).  At \(R=3\), order the sixteen parameters as
\[
 (\beta,\gamma,u_1,v_1,u_2,v_2,
 \kappa_{0,2},\kappa_{1,2},\kappa_{2,2},\kappa_{t,2},\kappa_{y,2},
 \kappa_{0,3},\kappa_{1,3},\kappa_{2,3},\kappa_{t,3},\kappa_{y,3})
\]
and set the coordinate with zero-based index \(i\) to \((i+2)(i+3)/(i+1)\).  Direct exact differentiation gives
\[
 \det D\Phi_{2,3}
 =-\frac{166587406248024637038592}{2460375}\ne0.
\]
The point is legal because all order-two cumulants are positive and each order-two--three pair is realized by a centered two-point law.  Thus the complete map is locally one-to-one there; in particular, the proposed local positive-dimensional unequal-effect fiber architecture does not apply to the intermediate case \((\ell,R)=(2,3)\).  Any unequal-effect ambiguity at that order must arise from a separate discrete real branch.
